package com.acme.payments.service;

import com.acme.payments.gateway.AcquirerClient;
import com.acme.payments.gateway.AuthorizationResponse;
import com.acme.payments.validation.CardValidator;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.Objects;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class PaymentService {

    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PaymentService.class);
    private static final BigDecimal SCA_THRESHOLD = new BigDecimal("30.00");

    private final AcquirerClient acquirer;
    private final CardValidator cardValidator;

    public PaymentService(final AcquirerClient acquirer, final CardValidator cardValidator) {
        this.acquirer = Objects.requireNonNull(acquirer);
        this.cardValidator = cardValidator;
    }

    public AuthorizationResponse authorize(final String pan, final int expMonth, final int expYear,
                                           final BigDecimal amount) {
        if (!cardValidator.isValidNumber(pan)) {
            return AuthorizationResponse.declined("INVALID_PAN");
        }
        if (cardValidator.isExpired(expMonth, expYear)) {
            return AuthorizationResponse.declined("EXPIRED");
        }
        final boolean needsSca = amount.compareTo(SCA_THRESHOLD) > 0;
        log.debug("authorizing {} (sca={})", amount, needsSca);
        final AuthorizationResponse response = acquirer.authorize(pan, amount, needsSca);
        if (response.isApproved()) {
            return resp
